# Launch Screen Assets

These images are the original Up2048 tile-grid logo (CC0), generated from
`assets/images/splash_logo.png` at 1x / 2x / 3x. `LaunchScreen.storyboard`
centres the image on a `#2B2D42` background. See `ASSETS_LICENSE.md`.

To replace them, drop new images here or edit the project in Xcode with
`open ios/Runner.xcworkspace`.
